Tidy LE8 scores into long format

Source: R/methods-tidy.R
tidy.essential8_scores.Rd

Reshapes the composite and component scores returned by score_le8() into long format, with one row per input row and measure. This is the shape ggplot2 and grouped summaries expect.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'essential8_scores'
tidy(x, id_cols = NULL, composite = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

An essential8_scores object returned by score_le8().

id_cols

Optional character vector of columns in x to carry into the result, such as a participant identifier. Defaults to the grouping columns when x is a grouped tibble, and to none otherwise. Scores from score_le8_imputed() always carry .imp (and .id, when present).

composite

Whether to include the composite score as a measure.

...

Not used.

Value

A data frame of the same type as x (a tibble for tibble input), ungrouped, with the columns:

  • row: the row of x the score comes from.

  • the id_cols.

  • le8_population: "adult" or "pediatric".

  • measure: a factor; composite (when included), then diet, physical_activity, nicotine, sleep, bmi, blood_lipids, blood_glucose, and blood_pressure.

  • score: the score, from 0 to 100, or NA when unavailable.

See also

summary.essential8_scores(), plot.essential8_scores()

Examples

adults <- read.csv(system.file(
  "extdata", "le8-adult-example.csv", package = "essential8"
))
adults <- adults[!startsWith(names(adults), "expected_")]
scores <- score_le8(adults)
head(tidy(scores, id_cols = "id"), 9)
#>   row              id le8_population           measure score
#> 1   1 optimal_general          adult         composite   100
#> 2   1 optimal_general          adult              diet   100
#> 3   1 optimal_general          adult physical_activity   100
#> 4   1 optimal_general          adult          nicotine   100
#> 5   1 optimal_general          adult             sleep   100
#> 6   1 optimal_general          adult               bmi   100
#> 7   1 optimal_general          adult      blood_lipids   100
#> 8   1 optimal_general          adult     blood_glucose   100
#> 9   1 optimal_general          adult    blood_pressure   100
